summary: The app-polish feature is fully implemented and correctly addresses all 6 subtasks. (1) println! → info!(): Two println! calls in Application::init() replaced with info!(). No remaining println!/eprintln! in production code (only in test modules and doc comments). (2) EditorHidden: Already in correct location at components/scene/editor_hidden.rs — no move needed. (3) AmbientLight: Moved from components/rendering/lighting.rs to resources/ambient_light.rs, re-exported via resources/mod.rs, registered as ECS resource via world.insert_resource() in Application::init(). Old location fully cleaned. (4) Debug fields: particle_readback_pending and particle_readback_done gated with #[cfg(debug_assertions)] on both the struct definition in mod.rs and initialization in builder.rs. All usage sites in renderer.rs also properly gated. (5) GltfCache type alias: Created in util/mod.rs as `pub type GltfCache = FileCache<GLTFModel, Box<dyn Fn(&PathBuf) -> GLTFModel>>`, replacing the inline type and removing #[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]. Used consistently in mod.rs and builder.rs. (6) Duplicate text input: Removed redundant event.text handler from KeyboardInput processing. winit 0.30 exclusively uses Ime::Commit for text input, making the old handler a source of double input. All verifications pass: cargo check --workspace (exit 0), cargo clippy -p katla_app -- -D warnings (exit 0).
